reproduction.sourceVersion: before: git show baselineCommit:modulePath; after: checked-out modulePath; SHA-256 of both recorded above.
reproduction.execution: TypeScript transpileModule to CommonJS with the existing runtime abort helper stubbed; invoke translateFreeTextChunks(text, limit, recordingEcho, undefined, words) for every sample. Raw chunks call splitFreeTextChunks with the respective transport-default words value (before false, after true).
reproduction.limitation: Synthetic low limits isolate boundary decisions; only actual-2000-budget uses a production provider budget. Request count increases are reported; translation semantics require separate real-provider review.

validation.scope: Deterministic unit and provider-port tests; network transports are mocked. No real-provider semantic, Firefox, Safari, mobile-device or user acceptance claim.
